name: Jordan Rivera

email.subject: VP Operations role at Harborline Software
email.body:
Hi Priya,

In August 2026 Harborline posted a VP Operations role to run implementation, support, and training as one team, with a promise of live in 60 days. That's work I've done.

Quick on me: Director of Operations at Tidewater Freight Systems, 14 years in logistics software.

- **I've cut go-live time:** average implementation from 16 weeks to 9 weeks.
- **I've raised retention:** helped raise gross revenue retention from 89% to 95% in three years.
- **I've run the whole post-sale team:** 64 people and an $11.2M operating budget.
- **I've integrated an acquisition:** 38 people and 120 customers onto one platform in 7 months, keeping 97%.

Would you have 20 minutes in the next two weeks?

Resume attached.

Regards,
Jordan Rivera
(704) 555-0142
